svg.title: Sahar at 48 px: main expressions, today vs proposed small-size set
svg.desc: View at 100% zoom: each figure is drawn at her real Small size (body 48 px wide). Rows 1-2: today's rig, scaled down (glows, thin strokes, emoji/mark orbs). Rows 3-4: the proposed 48 px level of detail: 1.5 px minimum strokes, eyelid cuts instead of brows, one highlight, mood contour, matte orb of at least 20 px with drawn marks, no halo or outside stars.

g.text: Sahar at Small (body 48 px) — view at 100%
Today's orb glyphs are emoji or Segoe marks at 6.6 px. Proposed: drawn marks on a matte orb (≥20 px). Contour, sky and eyelid cuts as in variant B.
